description: The brand's last-known DNA competitor set: the closest competing brands RivalSweeper identified for a domain, each with name, website, country and match tier, plus the brand's own DNA profile. Signed in with RivalSweeper and asking about your own store, also: rival suggestions from market signals (sites you do not track yet that rank for your searches, name your brand in their ads, or advertise in your market with your category words, each reason with its link and date), your current rivals ranked by how closely they overlap your store, and your rivals' own sites on other domains. Freshness-stamped. Included in RivalSweeper plans (developer API keys: 2 credits, no data = no charge).
name: find_closest_competitor_brands
title: DNA competitors for a brand
